description: This file defines a report class for Employee Hours Utilization based on Timesheet data in an ERP system, including methods for data processing, validation, and chart generation.

classes.name: EmployeeHoursReport
classes.description: Class for generating Employee Hours Utilization Report based on Timesheet data, including data validation, calculation, and visualization methods.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Entry point function that initializes and runs the EmployeeHoursReport, returning report data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor initializing the report with filters and setting date ranges.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Validates that the 'from' date is before the 'to' date.

methods.name: validate_standard_working_hours
methods.description: Ensures standard working hours are set in HR Settings; throws error if not.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Generates report columns, data, summary, and chart data, then returns them.

methods.name: generate_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure of report columns.

methods.name: generate_data
methods.description: Processes time logs, calculates utilization, and sorts data.

methods.name: filter_stats_by_department
methods.description: Filters employee stats by department if specified.

methods.name: generate_filtered_time_logs
methods.description: Fetches filtered timesheet detail data from the database.

methods.name: generate_stats_by_employee
methods.description: Aggregates billed and non-billed hours per employee.

methods.name: set_employee_department_and_name
methods.description: Retrieves employee name and department for each employee.

methods.name: calculate_utilizations
methods.description: Calculates total hours, untracked hours, and utilization percentages.

methods.name: generate_report_summary
methods.description: Creates summary metrics including averages and totals.

methods.name: generate_chart_data
methods.description: Prepares data for visualization in bar chart format.
